notes.title: v2.1 Patchfix notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Rebuilt game with the latest engine version to try to solve the achievements not working issue
[*] Updated to prevent in-game achievement notifications from popping up more than once if already seen
[*] Updated to keep name boxes from disappearing when the text box is made more transparent
[*] Added updated end title cards to better reflect current state of the game
[/list]
